props.name: columns
props.description: Required. Column definitions: key, header, optional sortable flag, className and a cell renderer. Example: columns={[{ key: "email", header: "Email", sortable: true }]}

props.name: data
props.description: Required. Rows rendered by the table; each column key is read from every row. Example: data={users}

props.name: searchable
props.description: Render the search box that filters rows across all columns. Example: searchable={false}

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Rows per page before the previous/next footer appears. Example: pageSize={25}

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Message shown in place of rows when no row matches the filter. Example: emptyText="No users yet."

props.name: onRowClick
props.description: Called with the clicked row, which also makes rows show a pointer cursor. Example: onRowClick={(row) => open(row.id)}

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class names for the table wrapper. Example: className="mt-4"
